title: Pogorelov interior estimates for sum-of-Hessians equations
summary: In this paper, we develop a new approach to sum-of-Hessians equations involving multiple $k$-Hessian operators of distinct orders. By exploiting the concavity of sums of Hessian operators, we derive Pogorelov estimates for the corresponding equations under the dynamic semi-convexity condition. Moreover, when the highest order is $n-1$ or $n$, we establish such estimates for admissible solutions without relying on this condition, and they are therefore optimal.
